github.reason: The owned open finding is verified fixed, so resolve it without a courtesy reply.
The existing contract and regression evidence disprove the published blocker; explain the retraction, then resolve.
The retry-path data loss remains reproduced, so the original blocker stays open despite the primary-path fix.
Documented supported configuration and reproduction establish the defect; claimed lack of use does not remove the contract.
The existing equivalent explanation and open state already match the unchanged evidence, so no duplicate thread write is needed.
The risk-bearing migration file is unavailable; preserve the open state and request the missing evidence because coverage cannot be completed.
A promised fix in an unmerged request does not fix or defer the reproducible blocker.
The optional improvement has an accepted tracked deferral, so explain the deferral and resolve without claiming a fix.
The accepted fix and resolved state were already reported and remain valid; no duplicate action is warranted.
Current verification reproduces the original blocker, and lint does not exercise it; explain and reopen the owned thread.
An outdated position does not remove a reproduced defect; record the new location and keep the thread open.
The fix is verified, but another reviewer owns the thread and no delegation permits changing its state.
Ownership follows the publishing account, not human or model origin; the verified fix permits resolution.
Draft mode must leave published discussions untouched while creating an unpublished pending review.
Analysis-only mode authorizes no platform writes and leaves the published discussion untouched.
Resolve the satisfied original null finding and publish the independently caused data leak as a new blocker.
The fix is accepted, but the 403 and unresolved read-back prevent claiming closure; report the unperformed closure.
The timed-out explanation may have posted; inspect before retrying and stop further mutations while the outcome is ambiguous.
The authoritative head changed before writes; stale analysis must be discarded and head B reviewed before publication.
The accepted finding is a general comment with no resolvable thread, so no state mutation is available.
A later reply does not transfer ownership from the other account that started the thread.
Unknown original authorship forbids state changes; a later model-marked reply from the publishing account does not establish ownership.
